home.badge: Applications open for the new season
home.title: MT Club: Where ambitious minds build together
home.lead: MT Club (Medical Technology) is a community where members learn, create, and grow together through workshops, projects, and events across its committees.
home.ctaTitle: Ready to be part of it?
home.ctaText: Membership is free and open to everyone who loves learning.

features.title: Learn
features.description: Build practical skills through workshops led by people who love to share what they know.

features.title: Build
features.description: Turn ideas into real projects, side by side with a team that helps you move forward.

features.title: Connect
features.description: Meet curious people, find your collaborators and make room for new perspectives.

home.intro: MT stands for Medical Technology, reflecting the club’s focus on learning and innovation in medical technology and related fields.

about.title: A club built on curiosity.
about.lead: MT Club brings curious people together to learn by doing, share what they know and make meaningful things as a community.
